items.headline: Indian Supreme Court protects NRI buyers from stalled loans
items.summary: A recent court ruling safeguards UAE-based non-resident Indians from continuing loan repayments if under-construction housing projects stall. Banks must now prove adherence to disbursement guidelines before pursuing borrowers.
items.why: It affects cross-border financing risks for expatriate investors purchasing property abroad.
items.impact_reason: Protects buyer finances and lender accountability during project delays.

bullets: On Tuesday 24 November, Dubai recorded 507 sales worth AED 1.6bn, which is 5.4% above a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 61.7% of sales, compared to a 7-day average of 57.2%.
The median price was AED 1,776 per sq ft, up 4.9% against the 30-day average and down 2.0% year-on-year.
Over the past 7 days, the busiest areas were JVC with 210 sales, Business Bay with 135 sales, and DAMAC Lagoons with 129 sales.
In October new contracts, JVC 1-bedroom apartments had a median rent of AED 69,812 a year, rising 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: The Indian Supreme Court has issued a ruling protecting NRI buyers from stalled loans, which helps reduce cross-border financing risks for expatriate investors.
Etihad Rail has launched passenger services for holiday travel, which improves regional accessibility and property appeal.
A new platform now allows first-time buyers to reduce their down payment, directly impacting buyer affordability.

items.headline: Free zone companies must comply with transfer pricing rules
items.summary: Maintaining the zero percent corporate tax rate requires strict adherence to transfer pricing regulations. Businesses must follow the arm's length principle to retain their qualifying status.
items.why: Corporate tax compliance directly affects business operating costs and investor sentiment in free zones.
items.impact_reason: Affects corporate tax eligibility and operational costs.

items.why: Massive aviation infrastructure expansion will drive long-term residential and commercial demand nearby.
items.impact_reason: Boosts long-term regional property demand.
